newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi to repay farmers $853 mln in August.
newsitem.headline: Saudi to repay farmers $853 mln in August.

text.p: Saudi Arabia will next month start paying 3.2 billion riyals ($853 million) owed to holders of special farmers' certificates which mature in August, the Saudi newspaper al-Riyadh said on Wednesday.
"The Saudi Finance and National Economy Ministry will next month start cash payment of the second tranche of farmers' certificates worth 3.2 billion riyals," the daily said.
Riyadh last year issued some nine billion riyals worth of special payment certificates to around 30,000 mainly wheat and barley farmers to meet government arrears.
Faced with huge Gulf War debts and soft oil prices until early 1996, Saudi Arabia fell behind on payments to farmers, causing painful cash crunches.
The first of three tranches of the certificates matured on August 31, 1996. The second tranche matures next month and the third tranche expires in August 1998.
